name: flaggems_nextafter_
description: In-place nextafter_: for each element, advance x toward y to the next representable floating-point value (IEEE 754). Extracted from FlagGems test_nextafter_ / benchmark BinaryPointwiseBenchmark.
reference:
import torch


def run(x, y):
    # In-place nextafter: mutate x toward y and return it.
    x.nextafter_(y)
    return x


def gen_inputs(ctx, device):
    # Boundary inputs combining NaN, +/-Inf, +/-0, and torch.finfo extremes,
    # mirroring test_nextafter_nan / _inf / _finfo_extremes / _zero_boundary.
    finfo = torch.finfo(torch.float32)
    x = torch.tensor(
        [
            float("nan"), 1.0, 2.0, float("nan"),
            1.0, float("inf"), float("-inf"), 0.0,
            0.0, finfo.max, -finfo.max, finfo.tiny, -finfo.tiny, finfo.eps,
            0.0, -0.0,
        ],
        dtype=torch.float32,
        device=device,
    )
    y = torch.tensor(
        [
            3.0, float("nan"), 4.0, 5.0,
            2.0, float("inf"), float("-inf"), float("inf"),
            1.0, float("inf"), float("-inf"), 0.0, 0.0, 0.0,
            -1.0, 1.0,
        ],
        dtype=torch.float32,
        device=device,
    )
    return {"x": x, "y": y}


def valid(ref_outputs, sol_outputs, inputs, ctx):
    import torch
    sol0 = sol_outputs[0].detach()
    ref0 = ref_outputs[0].detach()
    dt = sol0.dtype
    rtol_map = {
        torch.float16: 1e-3,
        torch.bfloat16: 1.6e-2,
        torch.float32: 1.3e-6,
        torch.float64: 1e-7,
    }
    rtol = rtol_map.get(dt, 1.3e-6)
    atol = 1e-4
    ref = ref0.to("cpu").to(torch.float64)
    sol = sol0.to("cpu").to(torch.float64)
    if ref.shape != sol.shape:
        return {"passed": False, "message": f"shape {sol.shape} vs {ref.shape}", "metrics": {}}
    both_nan = torch.isnan(ref) & torch.isnan(sol)
    both_posinf = torch.isposinf(ref) & torch.isposinf(sol)
    both_neginf = torch.isneginf(ref) & torch.isneginf(sol)
    finite = torch.isfinite(ref) & torch.isfinite(sol)
    close = torch.zeros_like(ref, dtype=torch.bool)
    close[finite] = (ref[finite] - sol[finite]).abs() <= atol + rtol * ref[finite].abs()
    ok = (close | both_nan | both_posinf | both_neginf).all().item()
    return {"passed": bool(ok), "message": "", "metrics": {}}
